# Third-party code, patched

Six crates of [PdfCraft](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft) (MIT OR Apache-2.0, licences in each
folder) at rev `d3a91c5c5f7b33dd39bc2ed8b5d3916960736d24`, copied here with the changes below (marked "Sheaf:" in the code) and used through the `[patch]` table of the
workspace `Cargo.toml`. Every other PdfCraft crate still comes from git at the same rev. The changes
to cos and engine's `mark_saved` make large documents fast; measured on a 1,982-page, 70 MB book (`reader_doc::tests::edit_cost_on_a_big_file`).

| Crate | Change | Before → after |
|---|---|---|
| `pdfcraft-cos` | `EDITOR_CACHE_OBJECTS` (src/document.rs) 1,024 → 65,536. After each edit the engine walks every page twice (comment list, missing appearances); a 1,024-object cache was emptied on every walk and the file parsed and inflated again. The 32 MB byte budget is kept by a full accounting pass every 1,024 inserts (the fast path skipped it for small objects). `ObjectReader` keeps a running total of its cache instead of summing it on every read. | annotation 2.13 → 0.20 s, undo 2.0 → 0.19 s, open 8.6 → 4.5 s; peak memory 370 → 465 MB |
| `pdfcraft-annot` | Text box fonts (`src/appearance.rs` `TEXT_FONTS`, `da_font`; `text_box_height`; `src/lib.rs` `set_text_font` (font, size, alignment; the box grows down to keep its text), `text_fonts` (read-only, one page-tree walk), restyle and rich text keep the font; `src/links.rs` `write_appearance`: a visible link gets an appearance stream for its border, which readers that draw only appearances did not show). Upstream drew every text box in Helvetica whatever its `/DA` said; now the 12 standard fonts named by Acrobat's resource names (Helv, TiBo, CoOb…) are drawn and measured with their exact metrics. `src/tests.rs` (upstream's tests) is left out. | text box font family, bold, italic |
| `pdfcraft-edit` | Header, footer (page numbers) and watermark fonts (`src/lib.rs`: `HeaderFooter::font`, `Watermark::font`, `mark_font`, `add_mark_font`). Upstream set them in Helvetica only; now any of the 12 standard text fonts, measured with its metrics. Also `reload` (one page read again instead of the whole page tree after each page: numbering 1,982 pages 83 → 13 s) and a watermark underline. `src/text_regions.rs` `rewrite_styled_block`: a rewritten row's runs share one text object; in separate ones, two that touch mid-word (a source run ending in "doul", the next starting "eurs") were read back as separate labels and the paragraph fell apart on the next edit (`sheaf-core/tests/edit_text.rs`). `src/text.rs`: `TextBlock::soft_breaks` (which row breaks are wraps, so the reader's editor shows them as spaces and an edit rewraps the paragraph) and `edited_spans` matching the draft to the old text with a Myers diff (upstream kept only the common start and end, so everything between two changes, or between wraps turned into spaces, took one style). `src/paths.rs` (Sheaf): drawings (painted vector paths, not clips) are objects of Edit a PDF, `ObjectKind::Path`, moved by `move_objects` in a `q cm … Q` wrap (none offered past 4,000 on a page), and deleted with the other picked objects by `delete_objects` (`src/objects.rs`; a drawing's operators are dropped by `delete_paths`, paragraphs cleared, images and added items removed, one step). `reading_lines` parses the page's content streams joined, as `text_lines` does (a TJ cut between two streams lost its text state: its text was exported at 1 pt in the page's corner). Sheaf's tests of these are in `src/text.rs` `sheaf_tests`, run by the suite's unit layer (`cargo test -p pdfcraft-edit --lib`); upstream's `mod tests` line and its helper `stream_bytes` are taken out with `src/tests.rs`. `src/tests.rs` (upstream's tests) is left out. | page numbers and watermark font family, bold, italic; a paragraph edited twice stays one |
| `pdfcraft-export` | PDF to Word as editable paragraphs and tables (F-005, dev/features/F-005): `Page::rules` and `Page::fills`, `ruled_tables` (grid from the rules, merged cells, shading, title bands), cells as paragraphs of styled runs, `Block::font` and `Block::para` (runs grouped into paragraphs), margins from the content, tables fitted to the page. `floating`, `layers`: rotated text outside ruled tables, watermark-sized text over other text and a picture covering half the page under the text float over a page that otherwise flows (a watermark no longer turns the page and its tables into text boxes). `pptx.rs`'s LibreOffice test skips when Impress is missing. Engine (`compare.rs` `export_pages`) and edit (`reading_paragraphs`, `page_fills`, public `TextLine::rotation`) feed it. Upstream's tests are inline and kept. | — |
| `pdfcraft-ocr` | Accented Latin (F-006, dev/features/F-006-ocr.md): `src/latin.rs` reads the lines ocrs finds with PaddleOCR's PP-OCRv5 Latin recognition model (Apache-2.0, `latin-recognition.onnx` + `latin-dict.txt` beside ocrs' models, fetched by `scripts/fetch-models.sh`); `Models::latin`, `Models::reads_accents`; `LANGUAGES` lists the model's languages; `text_layer` writes words WinAnsi cannot carry (α, →) in `/PCUni`, a glyphless Unicode font (pdfcraft-edit `glyphless_font`, Tesseract's `pdf.ttf` as `src/glyphless.ttf`). Without the model, ocrs reads as upstream. rten's `onnx_format` feature. Upstream's tests are inline and kept. | "Pr?valence" → "Prévalence" |
| `pdfcraft-engine` | `Session::mark_saved` (src/lib.rs): after an incremental save (old file + appended update, objects keep their numbers) the light refresh of a comment edit instead of the full re-inspection. A full rewrite (Save As) keeps the full refresh. Also `Edit::AddTextBox` (a text box added in a font, one undo step), `Edit::SetTextFont` and `Session::text_box_fonts`, over pdfcraft-annot's change; `typed_signature_shape_from` / `typed_signature_graphic_from` (a typed signature in another handwriting font, `sheaf-core/src/script.rs`). `Document::font_substituted`: the font an edited paragraph drew characters in that its own lacks (the reader says so, as Acrobat). `Edit::DeleteObjects` (pdfcraft-edit's `delete_objects`). `Document::stamp_picture_file` (src/copy_image.rs): the picture a stamp's appearance draws, so a copied picture stamp is pasted with it (XFDF carries no appearance). `Document::form_font_base` (src/lib.rs): the base font a form's `/DR` font key stands for, so a field's font is told from its `/DA`. `src/tests.rs` (upstream's tests, 250 KB) is left out. | ⌘S 4.6 s → see DECISIONS |

**To update PdfCraft:** bump the rev in the workspace `Cargo.toml` and in each `Cargo.toml` here, copy
`crates/annot/src`, `crates/cos/src`, `crates/edit/src`, `crates/engine/src`, `crates/export/src` and `crates/ocr/src` of the new rev over these, re-apply the changes (search for
"Sheaf:"), run `bash scripts/test.sh`. Drop a folder once upstream carries its change.
